checks.name: phase_e_dsp_files_exist
command: test -f Source/DSP/MultibandCrossover.h && test -f Source/DSP/MultibandCrossover.cpp && test -f Source/DSP/MultibandZone.h && test -f Source/DSP/MultibandZone.cpp && test -f Source/DSP/MultibandEngine.h && test -f Source/DSP/MultibandEngine.cpp && test -f tests/MultibandTests.cpp

checks.name: cmake_lists_lists_phase_e_sources
command: rg -q "MultibandCrossover\.cpp" CMakeLists.txt && rg -q "MultibandZone\.cpp" CMakeLists.txt && rg -q "MultibandEngine\.cpp" CMakeLists.txt && rg -q "MultibandTests\.cpp" CMakeLists.txt

checks.name: lr4_crossover_api_present
command: rg -q "Crossover|crossover|LR4|Linkwitz|Butterworth" Source/DSP/MultibandCrossover.h Source/DSP/MultibandCrossover.cpp && rg -q "setCrossover|crossover1|Crossover1|f1|Weight|Body" Source/DSP/MultibandCrossover.h Source/DSP/MultibandCrossover.cpp

checks.name: multiband_zone_dynamics_present
command: rg -q "EnvelopeFollower|threshold|attack|release" Source/DSP/MultibandZone.h Source/DSP/MultibandZone.cpp && rg -q "solo|mute|bypass|transient|sustain" Source/DSP/MultibandZone.h Source/DSP/MultibandZone.cpp

checks.name: processor_wires_multiband_engine
command: rg -q "MultibandEngine" Source/PluginProcessor.h Source/PluginProcessor.cpp && rg -q "MultibandEngine" Source/DSP/MultibandEngine.h Source/DSP/MultibandEngine.cpp
